steps.en: Clone the repo into your agent's skills directory and run its setup
steps.zh: 把仓库克隆进 agent 的 skills 目录，跑它的 setup

steps.en: Registers the whole role command set and a headless browser the agent drives
steps.zh: 注册整套角色命令，并配一个 agent 能驱动的无头浏览器

component.zh: skills 目录 + browse 守护进程

steps.en: Point the product interview at your idea
steps.zh: 拿产品拷问对准你的想法

steps.en: Challenges your framing and writes the design doc the later skills read
steps.zh: 质疑你的框架，写出后续技能会读的设计文档

steps.en: Ask for a plan that has already been reviewed
steps.zh: 要一份已经过评审的计划

steps.en: Runs the CEO review, then design and DX if in scope, then eng; only taste calls come back
steps.zh: 先 CEO 评审，命中范围才跑设计与 DX，最后工程；只把品味抉择交回

steps.en: Hunts the bugs CI misses: /review fixes what it can, /qa drives a real browser
steps.zh: 找 CI 漏掉的 bug：/review 修能修的，/qa 开真浏览器跑一遍

steps.en: /ship syncs main, runs the tests, pushes and opens the PR
steps.zh: /ship 同步 main、跑测试、推送并开 PR

value.en: You run a team's sprint sequence, each step reading the last one's artifact, instead of retyping prompts
value.zh: 你走的是一支团队的冲刺顺序，每步读上一步的产物，而不是重打 prompt

sources: README.md Quick start + The sprint (command names and order; /office-hours writes a design doc that downstream skills read)
AGENTS.md Available skills (role groupings: plan-mode reviews, implementation, release, operational, browser, iOS, safety)
ARCHITECTURE.md:7-56 (Aside-first browsing, bundled headless Chromium daemon as the fallback engine)
setup (single-file installer: clone into skills dir, register the commands per host)
scripts/resolvers/review-army.ts + review/specialists/ (parallel specialist subagents dispatched by /review and /ship)
scripts/resolvers/constants.ts:164-174 (plan reviews dispatch a subagent) + scripts/resolvers/index.ts:101 CODEX_PLAN_REVIEW -> generateCodexPlanReview (or the outside Codex/Claude CLI)
bin/ (gstack-diff-scope, gstack-evidence, gstack-pr-title-rewrite.sh) and package.json bin (browse, make-pdf)
